response.why: batch: player B starts
2 lands with turn-1 Swiftspear (haste, attacks immediately) + turn-2 Piker. Three burn spells for reach. Solid aggressive start for mono-red; keeps the plan intact.
Play Mountain first — must land-drop every turn. Then cast Monastery Swiftspear (haste attacks immediately) to start my clock and apply early pressure.
Cast Monastery Swiftspear — haste attacks immediately for 1, prowess triggers on future burn, and starts my clock on turn 2. Building creatures > face burn when the opponent has no board yet.

attack-all is correct aggro. Leaf 0 (hold): Swiftspear untapped but idle—passive play wastes haste and doesn't progress my clock. Leaf 1 (attack): Deal 1 damage immediately as haste intends, start racing to 20. Opponent has no creatures yet to punish the tap. Burn spells handle their replies. Score: [30, 80].

Pass upkeep. Faerie Mastermind is summoning sick (can't attack this turn), so no urgency to remove it now. I'll draw next and gain better information about my main-phase plays. Removing it then (with Shock or Lightning Bolt) is fine—can't block flying, but let me decide post-draw instead of pre-draw.

Pass draw step. I've drawn Monstrous Rage (+2/+0 pump with persistent Monster token). Move to main phase where I can play land, kill Faerie Mastermind with Shock, cast a Piker, and set up combat. No benefit to casting instants in draw step before main-phase plays.

Play Mountain. Always land-drop first. This gives me 2 Mountains (2 mana), enough to play Mountain + cast Shock to kill Faerie Mastermind (2/1 flying), the threat I can't block. After Shock, I'll have 1 untapped Mountain left and Swiftspear ready for combat.

Cast Monstrous Rage on Monastery Swiftspear. Makes it 4/3 (1/2 + 2/+0 + 1/+1 role), which attacks into Faerie: I deal 4 damage (kills 2/1), Faerie deals 2 damage back (Swiftspear survives). Next turn Swiftspear is permanently 2/3 from the role token. This is better than Shock (kills Faerie but deals no damage) and better than passing (leaves Faerie in play). Efficient, aggressive line.

Target Monastery Swiftspear. Pump my own creature to 4/3 (1/2 base + 2/+0 from Rage + 1/+1 from Monster Role). This kills Faerie when it blocks in combat and leaves Swiftspear permanently 2/3 going forward.

Cast Lightning Bolt to the opponent's face (3 damage, brings them to 16). Then I'll attack with Swiftspear (4/3 with Monstrous Rage), which Faerie likely won't block (losing Faerie to save 4 life is bad for them). Total: 7 damage this turn, opponent at 12 life. Aggressive tempo.

Target player B (opponent) with Lightning Bolt. Deal 3 damage to their face (19 → 16 life). Then attack with Swiftspear (4/3 with Monstrous Rage) for 4 more damage. Total: 7 damage this turn, opponent at 12 life.

Leaf 0 (attack-none): too passive, no progress toward 20-damage win. Leaf 1 (unblocked): deal 6 damage (16→10 life), only 10 away from lethal, very strong position. Leaf 2 (blocked by Faerie): deal 5 damage, Faerie dies (good), but opponent at 11 life. Attack-all is clearly better; even the blocked case kills Faerie and advances the race.

Pass upkeep. I'm at 20 life, opponent at 11 (need 11 damage to win). Hold my burn and creatures for main phase after I draw. With Incinerate, Shock, and 2 Pikers in hand, I have 3+2+2+2 = 9 damage available, which gets them to 2 life. Drawing 1 more card might give me lethal path or other options.

Pass priority on opponent's main phase. They have Deep-Cavern Bat (1/1 flying) and Restless Reef (untapped, can become 4/4 deathtouch). I'm at 20 life, they're at 11 life. I have lethal in hand: Incinerate (3) + Shock (2) + 2x Goblin Piker (2+2) + Brute Force pump = 12 damage total. Let opponent pass, get back to my turn, then finish them.

Pass declare attackers. Deep-Cavern Bat is summoning sick (can't attack). Opponent likely won't attack this turn. I've lost Incinerate to the Bat's exile effect—now I have only Shock (2) + 2 Pikers (2+2) + Brute Force (pump). I need to wait for my turn to cast my remaining burn and creatures. Pass and get to my turn 7 main phase.

Pass end combat. Opponent didn't attack (Deep-Cavern Bat is summoning sick). No combat occurred. Pass through their end step and get to my turn 7 main phase where I cast my burn and creatures for the final push.

Pass end turn. Opponent's turn 7 is over. Now I'm on turn 8 with my main phase coming up. I have lethal: Shock (2) + Goblin Piker (2) + Goblin Piker (2) + Brute Force pump (makes one Piker 5/4) = 2+2+5 = 9 damage from the first batch, need 11 total, but I also have my 2 Mountains for mana. Time to close it out.

Pass upkeep. I'm on turn 8 and need to draw. Current damage calculation: Shock (2) + Piker (2) + Piker with Brute Force (5) = 9 damage. Opponent at 11 life. I'm 2 short, but I haven't drawn yet. Draw, then reassess in main phase.

Pass draw. Excellent—I drew Monastery Swiftspear! New damage math: Shock (2) + Swiftspear with Brute Force pump (4) + Piker (2) + Piker (2) = 10 damage. Opponent at 11 life → 1 life after my main phase attacks. Nearly lethal. Move to precombat main to execute the combo.

Cast Shock for 2 damage. Opponent 11 → 9. I have 1 red mana left from 2 Mountains. Sequence: Shock (2), then Brute Force (1) on Swiftspear, then attack with 3 creatures for 4+2+2=8 damage (Swiftspear with pump, 2 Pikers). Total 10 damage turn 8, leaving opponent at 1 life.

Target player B's life total. Shock deals 2 damage (11 → 9 life). Next I'll cast Brute Force on Monastery Swiftspear, then attack for 4 (Swiftspear with pump) + 2 (Piker) + 2 (Piker) = 8 damage. Total 10 damage this turn, leaving opponent at 1 life.

Cast Brute Force to pump Monastery Swiftspear. Swiftspear becomes 4/5 (gains +3/+1 permanent). Then I'll pass to combat and attack with Swiftspear (4 damage) + 2 Pikers (2+2 damage) = 8 damage. Total this turn: 2 (Shock) + 8 (combat) = 10 damage, bringing opponent to 1 life.

Pass upkeep. Opponent at 10 life with Kaito planeswalker on board. I have 2 Pikers and Swiftspear in hand, 2 Mountains available. Move to main phase to cast creatures and attack for lethal or near-lethal damage.

Pass draw phase. Move to main phase with Dragon Fodder in hand. Plan: cast Dragon Fodder ({1}{R} using both Mountains) for 2 goblin tokens, then attack with all creatures (2 tokens + 2 Pikers + Swiftspear) for 7 damage. Opponent at 10 → 3 life.
Cast first Goblin Piker ({R}). Two Pikers (4 damage) beats Dragon Fodder (2 damage) for immediate pressure. Tap Mountain to cast it.

Leaf 0 (no-blocks): Taking 6 damage drops me to 13 life, dangerously low with Kaito and Enduring Curiosity on board. Opponent's Enduring Curiosity also triggers twice (from Kaito and Bat), drawing 2 cards. Leaf 1 (block Kaito): Taking only 1 damage stays at 18 life, much safer. Sacrificing my 2/1 Goblin Piker is worth it to prevent 5 damage from Kaito and limit opponent's card draw. I still have 2 creatures in hand (Piker, Swiftspear, Dragon Fodder) to rebuild the board.
Pass upkeep. Move to draw phase and main phase. Opponent at 11 life, I'm at 18. Ready to cast creatures from hand (Piker, Swiftspear, Dragon Fodder) and attack for lethal or near-lethal damage.

Cast Goblin Piker ({R}). Tap Mountain to cast it. Leaves {R} for next spell. Then cast Monastery Swiftspear next for {R}. Total: 2/1 + 1/2 = 3 power on board to attack with. Opponent at 11 life, close to lethal.

Pass upkeep. Move to draw phase, then precombat main phase. I'm at 6 life (critical), opponent at 12. Need to assess board and decide on Monastery Swiftspear, Dragon Fodder, or Bonebreaker Giant. Game is still competitive despite the life loss.

Pass draw phase. Move to precombat main. At 6 life but opponent's threats are tapped (Floodpits Drowners summoning sick). Hold Shock for flexibility. Need to evaluate casting Monastery Swiftspear, Dragon Fodder, or setup Bonebreaker Giant for next turn.

Cast Monastery Swiftspear ({R}). Creates 1/2 creature to block or attack. Leaves {R} for Shock next to deal 2 damage (12→10). At 6 life, need to rebuild board while applying pressure. Dragon Fodder would give more creatures but Swiftspear + Shock damage is more immediate value.
Cast Shock ({R}). Deals 2 damage to opponent (12→10 life). Now have Monastery Swiftspear on board + 2 damage dealt this turn. Tap the untapped Mountain to cast Shock. Then pass to combat.
Target player B (opponent at 12 life). Shock deals 2 damage to bring them to 10 life. Maximizes damage output toward win condition. No creature on board warrants removal over direct damage.

Leaf 0 (don't attack): Safe play preserves Monastery Swiftspear (1/2) at 6 life but makes no progress. Leaves mana open for next turn. Leaf 1-2 (blocked): Disaster scenarios—my creature dies to Floodpits Drowner 2/1 for zero damage, a losing trade. Blocking is opponent's likely play. Leaf 3 (unblocked): Best case—deal 1 damage (10→9) and Swiftspear survives tapped. However, with 2 untapped 2/1 blockers available, blocking probability is high, making Leaf 0's conservative play safer overall. At 6 life, preserving board is critical.
